settings.heading: Let Us Beat Their Price
settings.subheading: Found a better jewelry price? Give us the chance to beat it.
settings.intro: Whether you have a recent custom quote, found a piece advertised online, or are considering another Group Buy, send it to us. Every submission is reviewed by a person.

settings.heading: Our strongest guarantee
settings.body: Have a written custom jewelry quote from another jeweler? If it is genuine, verified, materially comparable, and issued within the last 7 calendar days, we will match or beat the qualifying jewelry price.
settings.highlight: If we cannot match or beat it, you may receive 10% off one eligible CaratForUs purchase, up to $100.
settings.note: Older quotes are still welcome. We will review them and may offer a competitive price, without the guarantee or the 10% fallback.

settings.heading: You do not need a formal quote
settings.body: If you find a jewelry piece advertised online at a price you like, send us the live product link and the advertised price. We want the opportunity to review it and see if we can beat it.
settings.highlight: Found it online for less? Give us the chance to beat it.
settings.note: Online prices are reviewed one by one, with no guaranteed outcome. The match or beat guarantee and the 10% fallback apply only to qualifying recent written custom quotes.

settings.heading: Considering another Group Buy?
settings.body: Send us the offer: the link, the current advertised price, the specs, and the current tier or participation level if there is one. We will review it and tell you honestly whether we can match or beat it.
settings.note: A Group Buy review carries no guaranteed match or beat outcome and no 10% fallback.

settings.heading: How the 10% fallback works
settings.intro: If CaratForUs cannot match or beat a qualifying recent written custom jewelry quote, you may receive:
settings.offer: 10% off one eligible CaratForUs purchase, up to $100 maximum savings.
settings.eligible_items:
Eligible regular Buy Now merchandise
Custom Jewelry
settings.rules_items:
Valid for 90 days
Single use
Non-transferable
No cash value
Cannot be combined with another promotional discount unless CaratForUs expressly authorizes it
settings.foot: Online prices and competing Group Buys do not qualify for the fallback. The full terms below govern if anything here differs.

settings.title: What qualifies
settings.items:
A recent written quote
Comparable specifications
Custom or fine jewelry

settings.title: What happens next

settings.title: Which category yours falls into
settings.text: A recent written custom quote carries our guarantee. An advertised online price or a competing Group Buy we will still review honestly, but with no guarantee attached. We tell you which before you decide anything.
